verdicts.human_summary: When the branch ref file doesn't exist (packed refs), watchFile returns undefined and no branch watcher is installed, causing missed git state changes. Suggests adding a fallback watcher on the refs/heads directory.
verdicts.reasoning: No AI comment addresses the packed-refs scenario where the loose branch ref file doesn't exist and a fallback directory watcher is needed. AI Comment 1 is the closest but concerns a different failure mode (partial setup error + guard preventing retry), not the normal case of a missing ref file due to packed refs. AI Comments 0 and 3 address ENOTDIR from git worktrees, which is a different root cause entirely.
